displayText: Let's use it. Differentiate y equals e to the three x. The inside part is three x, and its derivative is three. So keep e to the three x exactly as it is, and multiply by three. The derivative is three e to the three x. Check it on the graph. At x equals zero, the curve is one unit high, and its slope is three, three times the height. One trap. Don't bring the power down like you would for x cubed. That rule needs x in the base, and here x is in the power, so the exponential stays whole.
